summary: validatePath() accepted any path that startsWith() an allowed directory, with no separator — an allowed /srv/data also admitted /srv/data-secrets, so a tool call read or wrote outside the configured roots.

safe.description: Containment is p === dir || p.startsWith(dir + path.sep)

notes: Verified by diffing the published 0.6.2 and 2025.7.1 tarballs (dist/index.js vs dist/path-validation.js). Before this fixture the rule accepted any startsWith() on the path as containment; it now requires a separator-anchored prefix, the same verdict node-security/no-arbitrary-file-access gives.
